text:
nina: Heads-up — competitor announced a routing controls feature that overlaps with our per-tenant routing. We need a quick call on parity vs doubling down on our policy editor. Customers are asking.
raj: Saw the announcement. Is it deep technical parity or surface-level UX? Their docs look pretty thin.
nina: Quick skim — tenant-level routing + SLO knobs. Sales already getting questions. @danielle any immediate risk?
ellen: Two pilots mentioned routing limitations; one said they'd delay go-live unless they see something within a month. Not churn yet but definitely a blocker for some deals.
sam: Their UI is basic. We can preserve our advanced policy editor as a differentiator but we need an MVP that unblocks sales quickly.
owen: Platform estimate: ~6 weeks for a safe end-to-end canary (basic tenant routing + metrics) if we reuse routing infra. ~12 weeks for a polished policy editor.
nina: Options I'm thinking: A) Fast parity MVP in ~6wks (minimal UI/CLI/docs). B) Wait and ship advanced policy editor in ~12wks. C) Hybrid: ship API-only parity (~4wks cut-scope) then policy editor later. Tradeoffs?
raj: Hybrid seems pragmatic. API-only in ~4wks if we restrict scope to tenant tag + simple SLO markers. Needs feature flags and a canary plan.
owen: We can gate at the routing layer per-tenant. Rollout reqs: feature flag, per-tenant telemetry, 7-day canary with no regressions, p50 latency within SLO, token throughput below 2x baseline during ramp.
nina: Draft launch criteria: 1) E2E tests green, 2) Canary with 3 customers for 7 days with no errors, 3) Observability dashboard for per-tenant latency/cost, 4) Docs + sales playbook ready. Everyone ok?
danielle: Add a "how to pitch" pilot kit for sales + rollback language. Need a short demo script.
raj: I'll add a small perf harness to the repo and own canary infra. For 4wk API-only scope: routes by tenant-id, SLO tag, API + CLI (no UI). If this works I'll put it in the next sprint.
nina: Decision: go hybrid. Ship API-only parity as a 4wk scoped spike, then follow with the policy editor. Owners: raj (eng), owen (platform), sam (design for later UI), danielle + ellen (customer comms). I'll spin up a GH epic and assign. Quick sync tomorrow 10am? @everyone :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flag branch created by raj at 2759880000
